Formation pathway and mechanism of action of succinate

Formation pathway and mechanism of action of succinate. When metabolic remodelling occurs in CVDs, the metabolic intermediate product succinate accumulates abnormally. Accumulated succinate undergoes a series of reactions both inside and outside cells, promoting the occurrence of disease
